source.title: NOAA NCEI ETOPO 2022 v1, 60 arc-second ice surface

files.encoding: int16 little-endian, signed metres above EGM2008 geoid; negative bathymetry
files.resampling: bilinear pixel-centre sampling, rounded to nearest metre

convention.unitVector: x=cos(lat)*cos(lon), y=cos(lat)*sin(lon), z=sin(lat); angles in radians (sim/terrain/geo.ts latLonToUnit)
convention.sampling: wrap longitude; bilinear float64; outer half-row blends to the mean polar row at each pole

limits: Approx. 9.8 km equatorial spacing. Narrow islands, coastlines, summits and trenches are smoothed. Ice surface, not bedrock. Climate/cover classes are approximate geographic rules, not measured land cover. Launch plateau is an explicit gameplay override.
